title: Transportation Project Manager
description:
At-a-Glance:
Are you ready to build your career by joining a multi-national MedTech organization. If so, our client is hiring a Transportation Project Manager.

Position Type:
  • Contract
  • Hybrid
Required
  • 4-year bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of experience in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Business, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience in transportation project management, heavy haul, or special freight operations
  • Proven experience managing over dimensional and overweight shipments
  • Strong understanding of transportation regulations, permitting, and compliance requirements
  • Experience working with freight forwarders, carriers, and heavy haul providers
  • Excellent communication, coordination, and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently in a fast paced environment
  • Strong project management skills with deep knowledge of heavy haul transportation, special handling requirements, and regulatory compliance across domestic and international freight movements.
  • Preferred Qualifications
    • 4-year bachelor’s degree specifically in: supply chain, Logistics, Engineering, Business, or a related field
    • 5+ years of experience in transportation project management, heavy haul, or special freight operations
    • Experience supporting industrial, infrastructure, energy, or large capital projects
    • Knowledge and familiarity with domestic and international transportation (road, rail, port, and ocean freight)
    • Project management certification (PMP or similar)
    • Experience working in a global organization
    • Proficiency in SAP or other ERP systems
    • Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM systems
Responsibilities:
  • Transportation Project Manager will oversee the end‑to‑end planning, coordination, and execution of over‑dimensional freight, heavy loads, and complex transportation projects.
  • Responsible for ensuring safe, compliant, and cost‑effective delivery of critical equipment through close coordination with internal stakeholders, logistics providers, carriers, and regulatory authorities.
  • Project & Transportation Management
  • Plan, coordinate, and manage end to end transportation projects involving over dimensional, overweight, and high value freight
  • Develop detailed transportation execution plans, including routing, mode selection, scheduling, warehousing/storage, and risk mitigation
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for transportation project execution from origin through final delivery
  • Heavy Haul & Special Handling
  • Coordinate heavy lift, heavy haul, and special handling requirements, including cranes, rigging, escorts, and specialized equipment
  • Ensure compliance with local, state, federal, and international permits, regulations, and safety requirements
  • Manage routing surveys, feasibility studies, and engineering input as required for complex moves
  • Stakeholder & Vendor Coordination
  • Collaborate with internal teams (proposal and project management teams, manufacturing, and procurement) to align transportation plans with overall project schedules
  • Select, manage, and oversee transportation providers, freight forwarders, carriers, and third party logistics partners
  • Cost, Performance & Risk Management
  • Identify and mitigate transportation risks related to scheduling, safety, compliance, and cost related concerns.
  • Monitor budgets, track transportation costs, and identify cost saving opportunities
  • Resolve delivery issues, delays, or disruptions while maintaining project timelines
  • Compliance & Documentation
  • Ensure all required transportation documentation is accurate and complete (letters of credit, permits, customs, insurance, bills of lading, etc.)
  • Adhere to Siemens Smart Infrastructure policies, quality standards, and EHS requirements
Get in Touch:
We want to hear from you! If you think you’d be a good match, submit your resume and reach out to Sparsh at (862) 895-5696 to learn more.

title: Licensed Practical Nurse
description:
Job Title: Licensed Practical Nurse
City: Belen
State: NM
Job Type: Contarct
Discipline: LPN/LVN
Speciality: LPN
Facility Setting: Short Term Acute Care (STAC)
Accepting Locals per Radius Rule? Yes
Contract Length: 13 weeks
Shifts: Nights
Shift Details: 12 Hours
Weekly Schedule: 36 Hours
Certifications:
  • BLS
Mandatory Experience:  
  • Under the direction of a Registered Nurse (RN), the Licensed Practical Nurse delivers efficient and effective nursing care while achieving positive clinical outcomes and patient/family satisfaction.
  • Operates within the scope of practice defined by the State Nurse Practice Act.
  • LPN contributes to nursing assessments and care planning, provides direct patient care, and supervises patient care provided by unlicensed staff.
  • Patient Evaluation:
    • Collects, reports and documents objective and subjective data;
    • Observes conditions and reports changes in condition to RN;
  • Care Planning:
    • Contributes to establishing individualized patient goals;
    • Assists in developing interventions to achieve goals;
    • Implements the plan of care;
    • Evaluates effectiveness of interventions to achieve patient goals and minimize re[1]hospitalizations;
    • Participates in review and revision of plan of care;
  • Provision of Direct Patient Care:
    • Administers medications and performs treatments per physician orders;
    • Communicates pertinent data to RN and/or physician;
    • Documents accurately and thoroughly;
    • Consults and seeks guidance from the RN as necessary;
    • At the direction of the RN, participates in Utilization Management or Interdisciplinary Care Management Meeting to facilitate appropriate discharge planning:
      • Communicates team’s recommendations for discharge to the attending physician, patient and family;
      • Prepares patient/family for discharge including patient and family education;
  • Monitors patient care provided by unlicensed staff:
    • Assigns duties as specified by State Nurse Practice Act, Genesis policy, and staff training;
    • Communicates patient information with unlicensed staff during and between shifts;
    • Monitors, evaluates and follows-up on assigned responsibilities of unlicensed staff;
    • Ensures that assigned tasks are performed in accordance with policies and procedures;
  • Uses Point Click Care (PCC) according to the Business Processes;
  • Performs drug count when beginning and ending shift and whenever necessary;
  • Assists physician in rounds and examination of patients, as needed;
  • Participates in shift-to-shift communication between incoming and outgoing nursing staff;
  • Collaborates and coordinates with other departments to provide timely effective care consistent with individual’s needs, choices and preferences;
  • Contributes to an environment that is respectful, team-oriented, and responsive to the concerns of staff, patients and families;
  • Enhances nursing practice by attending all mandated in-service programs;
  • Assists with the orientation of newly hired nursing staff;
  • Promotes a culture of safety to ensure a healthy practice and living environment;
  • Maintains confidentiality and protects sensitive Protected Health Information (PHI)
